concerns.text: The plan proposes using McNemar’s test for accuracy (binary outcome) while employing a Latin‑square design where each participant sees each buggy method under only one summary condition. McNemar’s test requires paired observations on the *same* items across conditions; with the current design the binary outcomes are not paired, violating the test’s assumptions. Consider either (a) redesigning the task allocation so that each participant evaluates the *same* buggy method under each condition (allowing true pairing), or (b) using a mixed‑effects logistic regression that accounts for participant and item random effects.
